title: Say a phrase aloud using text-to-speech
summary: Use the `say` command to have your Mac speak a phrase out loud. You can also save the speech to an audio file or read a text file.

steps.explain: Type the phrase you want the Mac to speak inside quotes.

placeholders.name: PHRASE
placeholders.description: The text you want the Mac to speak aloud.

alternatives.explain: Read the contents of a text file aloud.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the text file to read.

alternatives.explain: Save the spoken text to an audio file instead of playing it.

placeholders.name: AUDIO_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the .aiff file to create.

placeholders.name: PHRASE
placeholders.description: The text to convert to speech.
